description: Use this when someone asks a factual question about Pikes Peak, the Pikes Peak Highway, the Cog Railway, the Barr Trail, the Manitou Incline, Garden of the Gods, the Summit Visitor Center, the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, the Pikes Peak Marathon and Ascent, or history: elevation, distances, fees, hours, rules, parking, records, opening dates. Returns matching facts with value, unit, source URL and the date the source was checked. Example questions: "How tall is Pikes Peak?", "How many steps is the Manitou Incline?", "Is Garden of the Gods free?", "When is the Pikes Peak Hill Climb?". Not for a date-specific plan.
